This reduction in Acetyl-CoA can secondarily disrupt lysosomal function, linking the two disease modules.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that reduced Acetyl-CoA levels due to ACACA deficiency do not impact lysosomal function or protein degradation pathways. _(variant: rs121909531 (c.2089G>A, p.Gly697Arg in ACACA) with a gnomAD allele frequency > 0.001)_
